capsuleTopic.title: Sinai and the Ten Commandments
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Mountain · voice · Ten Words · covenant · tablets · breach · renewal
capsuleTopic.orientation: Enter Sinai as an Event: Israel approaches the mountain, hears the divine voice, receives the Ten Words and covenant ordinances, seals the covenant, breaches it, and remains through intercession, renewal, dwelling, and departure. Later witnesses recite and reuse the Event without replacing Exodus.
